documents.text: Checkmarx SAST Supported Languages: Microsoft SQL Server T-SQL stored procedures are supported when the supported-language package is enabled.
Checkmarx SAST Supported Languages: Oracle PL/SQL is a separate language entry. Do not infer T-SQL support from PL/SQL.
Checkmarx Engine Pack configuration: verify the selected Engine Pack version before a scan and record the applied package.
Helix QAC project analysis procedure: create or open the project, configure the compiler, then execute qacli analyze and review analysis results.
Helix QAC CCT generation: generate a Compiler Compatibility Template only when the compiler configuration is not already available for the project.
Validate Stream overview and configuration: a project stream groups project activity. Configure the Validate Stream in the project settings.
QAC to Validate CLI upload: run qacli validate build after analysis to upload analysis results to Validate.
Validate permission troubleshooting: confirm account permissions and the target project before retrying an upload that reports insufficient permission.
Helix QAC license configuration: configure the license server before analysis and verify the license connection.
Helix QAC IDE Plugin setup: configure the Eclipse or Visual Studio plugin after the QAC project is available.
